releaseItems.api: MiniAppsLibrary and Developer Studio use native NavigationStack/List and the existing per-window app roots.
releaseItems.gate: No source-qualified Duo device/layout acceptance was found. Responsive native controls alone do not prove the vendor-specific layout criterion.

releaseItems.api: MiniAppsDeveloperWorkspace.FolderStyle stores symbol/color metadata in .miniapps-folder.json; Studio can select local or the existing iCloud Documents/MiniAppsStudio root.
releaseItems.gate: Folder operations have portable Foundation coverage. Native coordination, remote updates, conflicts, offline behavior and iCloud entitlement acceptance remain open.

releaseItems.api: Studio copies canonical SDK gallery examples into an independent workspace and uses MiniAppAuthoringService validation/build; five real example projects include drawing.
releaseItems.gate: Five original validate/build pairs passed at 4d76 and qualified through 08ed. b80 changes authoring/SDK inputs; refresh the original gallery checks and then install/run accepted projects.

releaseItems.api: Original @expo/ui Button/Toggle props, WidgetToggleHandler, refresh-button props and HanlinExpoWidgetsViewRenderer.toggleIntent feed actual AppIntents; ScriptWidget retains its original button/toggle elements.
releaseItems.gate: Exercise persistent state, explicit requested Boolean, action identity, reload and disabled/removed packages on actual WidgetKit surfaces. Preview/decoder success is insufficient.

releaseItems.api: Original Expo SwiftUI views and ScriptWidget Gauge/Chart renderers remain canonical; typed manifests describe the authored widget tree.
releaseItems.gate: Verify actual rendered progress values and edge cases in applicable widget families. No drop-in ListWidget.addProgress global is claimed.

releaseItems.api: Widget containers permit system background removal; ScriptWidget supports authored background colors/materials and accessibility fallbacks. Its material implementation explicitly blurs widget content, not wallpaper.
releaseItems.gate: An iOS/iPadOS 27.2 real Home Screen check must establish wallpaper behavior and tinted/reduced-transparency handling. Local material rendering is not equivalent proof.

releaseItems.api: UIKit caret geometry positions suggestions; the original TypeScript authoring service returns completion/signature/documentation results with request/version guards and an API-reference link.
releaseItems.gate: Four original Node editor tests passed. Native keyboard, caret, selection, stale-response and accessibility execution remains required.

releaseItems.api: Native UITextView editor, explicit save/rename, draft recovery and guarded asynchronous validate/build live in the standalone Studio.
releaseItems.gate: Execute MiniAppsStudioProjectTests plus native editor acceptance. Source review and Linux parsing do not prove UIKit isolation, file-provider coordination or edit preservation.

releaseItems.api: The standalone library exposes Developer Studio; Studio provides project creation, folder creation, import, gallery and refresh actions.
releaseItems.gate: Functional routes exist. No literal tile design or bottom-plus parity is asserted; reconcile any exact UI requirement against the approved product plan.

releaseItems.api: Studio folder styling accepts a system symbol and color; native views render system images.
releaseItems.gate: Folder symbols do not establish a complete per-script icon chooser or installed-item icon editing workflow. Verify the required scope explicitly.

releaseItems.api: Studio searches and periodically refreshes the real RuntimeFileLayout logs; the displayed tail has an explicit 512 KB limit and full-file export.
releaseItems.gate: Verify actual engine output, filtering, tail updates, export and truncation messaging in the standalone app; this is not a simulated console.

releaseItems.api: UIFontPickerViewController supplies editor fonts, with persisted font name/size preferences.
releaseItems.gate: Native installed-font enumeration, fallback, Dynamic Type/accessibility and document editing still need execution.

releaseItems.api: Studio has persisted system/light/dark editor theme selection and applies preferredColorScheme to that editor.
releaseItems.gate: Editor-local themes do not prove the complete MiniApps Settings-list theme/icon presentation. Settings-row icons still require source/UI comparison; an alternate application icon workflow is not a release criterion.

releaseItems.api: No standalone release-notes/What's New implementation was identified in the audited Studio/library source.
releaseItems.gate: Record whether this comparison item is part of required product acceptance; do not mark it implemented or silently remove a required criterion.

releaseItems.api: Studio enumerates its selected workspace and refreshes on scene activation and explicit refresh; the iCloud root is explicit.
releaseItems.gate: No source-qualified proof of not-yet-downloaded placeholders was found. Test File Provider/iCloud visibility, download, foreground remote changes, conflicts and offline recovery on Apple platforms.

releaseItems.feature: Refresh resilience and retained successful content
releaseItems.api: HanlinWidgetLastSuccessfulRender validates installation, generation, engine, family, settings and program identity before fallback.
releaseItems.gate: Eleven original native cases cover validity boundaries. Their Apple execution and real WidgetKit scheduling/recovery remain open; the OS controls refresh timing.

releaseItems.api: Original ScriptWidget image decoding/modifiers and original widget renderers are retained; preview and host family contracts remain explicit.
releaseItems.gate: Nine image invocations need the UIKit branch on iOS. AppKit execution, preview construction or source parsing is not large-image iOS acceptance.

releaseItems.api: The NativeScript gallery drawing example uses actual UIKit drawing, explicit rotation and input checks; original ScriptWidget image rotation stays in the renderer.
releaseItems.gate: Canonical TypeScript/gallery build proof exists on earlier qualified source. Native output, invalid dimensions, clipping, scale and rotated-image review remain required; no DrawContext drop-in is claimed.

releaseItems.api: Workspace writes use coordinated compare-before-overwrite replacement intended to preserve existing file metadata. No corresponding public addTag/allTags/removeTag binding was identified.
releaseItems.gate: A general Files tag API is absent from this mapping. Metadata preservation during editor save also needs Darwin/File Provider tests; it is a separate narrower behavior.

releaseItems.api: HanlinRunMiniAppShortcutIntent is LongRunningIntent/CancellableIntent; allowLongRunning defaults false, while accepted work is enqueued before OS background/cancellation negotiation.
releaseItems.gate: Run original opt-in >300-second acceptance and cancellation/results checks. The historical Host suite's one skip is not credit for this gate.

releaseItems.api: The standalone intent uses the actual AppIntents background task API; typed reportShortcutProgress routes miniapps.shortcutProgress to real Progress updates.
releaseItems.gate: Check the OS indicator, progress, completion, cancellation and duplicate completion on supported iOS 27+; a portable continuation test cannot prove these surfaces.

releaseItems.api: HanlinWidgetFamily and prepared widget manifests include systemExtraLargePortrait alongside all seven other families.
releaseItems.gate: Decoder/source inclusion does not create OS support on every device. Test the applicable actual iPad/device dimensions and original family render/preview.

releaseItems.api: HanlinShortcutValueCodec validates text, JSON and JSON-file intent input; structured output is delivered as a real IntentFile when appropriate.
releaseItems.gate: Twelve portable codec cases passed. Native Shortcuts must exercise actual dictionary/list/file handoff and results without stringifying away types.

releaseItems.api: The standalone intent invokes an installed action with supportedModes including .foreground(.dynamic). Its current command delivery still sets continueInForeground:false and canPresentUI:false. The existing shared HanlinRunScriptActionIntent is a separate foreground installed-action contract.
releaseItems.gate: There is no inline-JavaScript input in the new intent. Actual system Open When Run/foreground-toggle presentation remains PROBE_UNKNOWN because dynamic foreground mode is already declared; a UI-permitted inline-script delivery contract is not established by that declaration.

releaseItems.api: Existing installed-action intents can be discovered by the system; no source-qualified MiniApps icon/setup guidance was identified.
releaseItems.gate: Verify actual OS-created Home Screen shortcuts, routing and user guidance. Do not equate a legacy in-app launch flag with Shortcuts-origin execution.

releaseItems.api: The production windowFactory path loads a cooperating window/session context in the original NativeScript VM without attaching a new UI; fresh store.restore guards generation/enabled admission.
releaseItems.gate: Run both original NativeScriptShortcutConcurrencyTests methods and window-close lifecycle regression against the current source. No separate JavaScript isolate/process isolation is claimed.

releaseItems.api: Hanlin uses explicit shortcuts delivery and canPresentUI=false for the standalone background action, with foreground continuation separately controlled.
releaseItems.gate: This is the local policy equivalent, not an exported Scriptable config.runsInApp global. Verify actual routing and any required compatibility contract.

releaseItems.api: Shared action entities use package/entrypoint/action identity and narrowly scoped legacy short-ID migration; preview and foreground/background paths remain separate.
releaseItems.gate: Existing saved Shortcuts, widget previews and run-in-app migration need actual version-upgrade OS acceptance. Source identity logic does not prove vendor-equivalent compatibility.

scope: Settings-list icons are not an alternate app icon requirement
.foreground(.dynamic) is present; OS foreground-toggle behavior remains a native probe
